injuries_home.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries_home.note: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries_home.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries_home.note: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries_home.name: Jordan Poole
injuries_home.note: Poole (ankle) won't return to Wednesday's game against the Nuggets. He finished with two points (1-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt), one rebound and one steal over seven minutes.

injuries_home.name: Yves Missi
injuries_home.note: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries_away.name: Dylan Cardwell
injuries_away.note: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries_away.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries_away.note: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries_away.name: Keegan Murray
injuries_away.note: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

injuries_away.name: Ben Simmons
injuries_away.note: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries_home.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries_home.note: Youngblood (ankle/two-way player) is out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

injuries_home.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries_home.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
